title: Collateral and Title Guideline: Releasing Parcels from a Farm Real Estate Loans Mortgage
content:
These clauses govern the release of mortgaged parcels from a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage.

## Clauses in force

**1. Loan status.** A parcel may be released only while the loan is in active or paid-off status, as shown on the loan's own system record: on payoff every parcel still mortgaged is released through the payoff, and while the loan is active one parcel of several may be released on its sale, on a public taking, or as a farmstead split.

**2. Once per parcel.** Each mortgaged parcel may be released only once; a release already recorded against the same parcel mortgage record means it cannot be released again.

**3. Request.** A partial release is registered as a partial release request naming the parcel number and the net sale price or award (0.00 for a farmstead split), and is made only while at least one other parcel remains mortgaged (parcels mortgaged to the loan less parcels released from it, beyond the one being released).

**4. Application of the release price.** The release price is applied to principal as release proceeds on the release date.

**5. Survey.** A tract smaller than the product's survey threshold in acres is released only on a recorded survey.

**6. Fees.** A release on sale or farmstead split carries the product's partial release fee; a release on condemnation carries no fee.

**7. Past-due installments.** No partial release is made while an installment is past due.

**8. Delivery.** The recorded release of mortgage is delivered within the product's release processing business days of approval or payoff.

## Clauses no longer in force

> The following clauses of this guideline are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis:
>
> - "The release price is the greater of the net sale price or award and the product's release premium percentage of the parcel's share of principal, that share being the principal balance times the parcel's appraised value divided by the loan's mortgaged collateral value, rounded to cents; for a farmstead split the release price is the premium amount alone."
> - The words following clause 4: "after which principal may not exceed the product's largest principal after a release, as a percentage of the value still mortgaged, and the combined loan-to-value test must be met, any excess being paid down at the same time."

## Judgement table for a partial release while the loan is active

| Release reason | Partial release fee | Other parcel must remain mortgaged | No installment past due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sale | yes | yes | yes |
| Public taking (condemnation) | no | yes | yes |
| Farmstead split | yes | yes | yes |

On payoff, every parcel still mortgaged is released, and the recorded release of mortgage is delivered within the processing period counted from the payoff.

**Survey boundary (hypothetical).** On a product whose survey threshold is 40 acres, a 12-acre farmstead tract carved out of a larger tract is released only on a recorded survey; a tract of 40 acres or more is not below the threshold.

superseded_clauses: after which principal may not exceed max_ltv_after_release_pct of the value still mortgaged and the combined test of farmland_agg_combined_ltv must be met, any excess being paid down at the same time.

The release price is the greater of the net sale price or award and partial_release_premium_pct of the parcel's share of principal, that share being principal_balance times the parcel's appraised_value divided by the loan's collateral_value, rounded to cents; for a farmstead split the release price is the premium amount alone.
